eq-ch05-wbx1-split: Well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction works on perturbations about the hydrostatic reference and restores it at faces.
eq-ch05-wbx1-rest: The discrete rest state: cell pressure equals the reference pressure plus one constant per column.
eq-ch05-refkernel-scan: Reference face pressures are scanned down the column, each face adding $g\bar\rho_i\Delta x_{1,i}$.
eq-ch05-refkernel-anchor: On one block the top face pressure is the top cell's pressure extrapolated isothermally by half a cell.
eq-ch05-refkernel-pref: On a uniform grid the reference cell pressure is the average of the quintic through six face pressures.
eq-ch05-refkernel-logmean: On a non-uniform grid the reference cell pressure is the log-mean of the two face pressures.
eq-ch05-refkernel-dens: Reference cell and face densities from the reference pressures and a binomially smoothed ratio $\chi = \rho/p$.
eq-ch05-refkernel-offset: The face-density offset of the default reference is $O(\Delta x_1^2)$, with the stated leading term.
eq-ch05-wallclamp-repeat: Repeating the wall value of $\chi$ past a wall biases the smoothed ratio in the first two cells by $3a/8$ and $a/16$.
eq-ch05-wallclamp-cont: Past a clamped wall the ratio $\chi$ is continued linearly or geometrically, by the sign of its slope.
eq-ch05-seam-relay: Below an $x_1$ seam, a block's top anchor is the bottom-face pressure of the block above.
eq-ch05-hsmode-force: The hydrostatic mode adds the cell's own face-pressure difference, weighted by $1 - \alpha_{\mathrm{nh}}$, to momentum and total energy density.
eq-ch05-balcol-iter: One `balance_column` sweep: set each cell pressure to its reference plus the top-cell gauge, at fixed $1/\chi = p/\rho$.
eq-ch05-balcol-res: `balance_column` stops when the largest balance residual, scaled by $\rho g \Delta x_1$, is below `rtol`.
eq-ch05-wbref4-face: Reference face density as the derivative of the quartic through the cumulative cell mass at five faces.
eq-ch05-x1cent-defect: On spherical-polar grids the $r^2$-weighted cell mean differs from the plain mean by $\delta_i \partial_1 q$, with $\delta_i \approx \Delta x_1^2/(6r^{\mathrm m}_i)$, the leading term of the exact offset.
eq-ch05-x1cent-conv: Plain cell means recovered from $r^2$-weighted means by a five-cell stencil exact for quartics.
eq-ch05-x1cent-source: The radial pressure source as the $r$-weighted integral of the quintic through six face pressures.
eq-ch05-oneoverr-favre: The Favre-mean velocity differs from the plain mean by a covariance term and a centroid-offset term.
eq-ch05-legacy-copy: The wall-face copy sets the outer pressure and density state equal to the inner one.
eq-ch05-refkernel-stretched: On a keyed stretched $x_1$ the reference cell pressure is the cell average of the degree-5 interpolant through six face pressures, with per-cell weights from the widths.
eq-ch05-wallclamp-steps: On a keyed stretched $x_1$ the wall continuation steps by the physical distance from the wall cell's centre to the mirrored ghost centre.
